metadata.question: Are more yellow areas visible in northern Lapland, Sweden, on October 10, 2016, than in September 2016

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Northern Lapland, Sweden (approximately 68-69°N, 20-23°E) - Dates: October 10, 2016 vs. September 2016 (full month) - Collection: Sentinel-2 for visual RGB data (yellow = autumn colors) - Yellow areas = high Red+Green, low Blue → (R+G)/(B+1) or similar index 2. Masking strategy: - Should mask clouds since we need clear visual assessment - Use QA60 band for cloud masking on Sentinel-2 3. Logic: - Calculate a "yellowness" index for both periods - Compare mean yellowness: October 10 > September mean = Yes (A), else No (B) - Handle C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid results) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define northern Lapland, Sweden region const lapland = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[20.0, 68.0], [23.0, 68.0], [23.0, 69.2], [20.0, 69.2], [20.0, 68.0]] ]); // 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2 function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Calculate yellowness index: (Red + Green) / (Blue + 1) function addYellowness(image) { const yellow = image.select('B4').add(image.select('B3')) .divide(image.select('B2').add(1)) .rename('yellowness'); return image.addBands(yellow); } // 4. Get September 2016 data let septCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(lapland) .filterDate('2016-09-01', '2016-09-30') .map(maskClouds) .map(addYellowness); const septSize = septCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('September 2016 images: ' + septSize); if (septSize === 0) { console.log('No September data, trying Landsat 8'); septCol = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lapland) .filterDate('2016-09-01', '2016-09-30') .map(function(image) { const yellow = image.select('SR_B4').add(image.select('SR_B3')) .divide(image.select('SR_B2').add(1)) .rename('yellowness'); return image.addBands(yellow); }); if (septCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // 5. Get October 10, 2016 data let octCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(lapland) .filterDate('2016-10-10', '2016-10-11') .map(maskClouds) .map(addYellowness); const octSize = octCol.size().getInfo(); console.log('October 10, 2016 images: ' + octSize); if (octSize === 0) { console.log('No Oct 10 data, trying nearby dates'); octCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterBounds(lapland) .filterDate('2016-10-08', '2016-10-12') .map(maskClouds) .map(addYellowness); if (octCol.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // 6. Calculate mean yellowness for both periods const septMean = septCol.select('yellowness').mean(); const octMean = octCol.select('yellowness').mean(); // 7. Reduce regions with pixel counting const septStats = septMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: lapland, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const octStats = octMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: lapland, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const septVal = septStats.yellowness_mean; const septCount = septStats.yellowness_count; const octVal = octStats.yellowness_mean; const octCount = octStats.yellowness_count; console.log('September yellowness: ' + septVal + ', Pixels: ' + septCount); console.log('October yellowness: ' + octVal + ', Pixels: ' + octCount); // 8. Validation and answer if (septCount === 0 || octCount === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (septVal === null || octVal === null || isNaN(septVal) || isNaN(octVal)) { console.log('C3'); return; } if (octVal > septVal) { console.log('October shows more yellow than September'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('October does not show more yellow than September'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
